content: Small-cluster quorum problem (GitHub etcd issues #863/#7906/#12128, DBA SE): 2-node Raft clusters (etcd/Consul/rqlite) need both nodes for quorum - one node down = no writes, no better than a single node; etcd recommends odd 3/5/7 clusters; new nodes cannot join without quorum, complicating recovery; minority-side nodes are read-only during partitions. Validated user pain point: always-writable 2-node HA needs an AP design (CRDT or quorumless), which mainstream KV stores do not offer.
